en_title: GTA 6 Developer Rockstar Insists Its Next Game Won't Take Another 8 Years to Make
subtitle: 下一站仍是未知数
opus_summary: Rockstar表示，《GTA6》之后的新作不会再耗时8年，但未透露具体作品。管理层称，本作开发期间建立的引擎、工具和团队，将为后续作品加快开发打下基础。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has promised that its next game following GTA 6 won’t take as long to come out, although it failed to hint at what it might be.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar承诺，《GTA6》之后的下一款游戏不会再让玩家等这么久，但没有透露任何关于新作的线索。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 finally launches in November, eight years after the release of its last game, Red Dead Redemption 2. In a new report by Bloomberg detailing the challenges Rockstar has faced during GTA 6’s development, company leadership said whatever’s next won’t take as long because the work done for GTA 6 provides a foundation for following it up faster.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》终于将在11月发售，距离Rockstar上一款游戏《荒野大镖客：救赎2》推出已过去8年。彭博社的一篇新报道详细介绍了Rockstar在《GTA6》开发期间面临的挑战。公司管理层在报道中表示，无论下一款作品是什么，都不会再耗时这么久，因为《GTA6》的开发工作已经打下基础，让后续作品能够更快推出。

paragraphs.en: “The engine, the tools and the team we’ve built during this project will allow us to do things more quickly,” Phil Hooker, co-head of development, said.
paragraphs.cn: 开发部门联席负责人Phil Hooker表示：「我们在这个项目中打造的引擎、工具和团队，将让我们能更快地推进工作。」

paragraphs.en: “I feel confident that we can build on top of this and go more sideways than upwards to build more compelling content.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我有信心，我们可以在这个基础上继续开发，更多地横向拓展，而不是向上提升，从而打造更有吸引力的内容。」

paragraphs.en: “We foundationally changed a lot of stuff on this project,” co-head of development Aaron Garbut added. “But now it’s done, and we’re not going to rip it apart.”
paragraphs.cn: 开发部门联席负责人Aaron Garbut补充道：「在这个项目中，我们从根本上改变了很多东西。但现在这些工作已经完成，我们不会再把它们推倒重来。」

paragraphs.en: The question fans have is, what will Rockstar’s next game be? Bloomberg compares the release of GTA 6 to GTA 3, in that the first 3D GTA game paved the way for the quickfire release of Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, which launched a year later in 2002. Could Rockstar soon follow GTA 6 with another GTA game, perhaps focused on another city?
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝们关心的问题是，Rockstar的下一款游戏究竟是什么？彭博社将《GTA6》的推出与《GTA3》作了比较：作为系列首款3D游戏，《GTA3》为《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》的快速推出铺平了道路，后者仅隔一年便于2002年发售。Rockstar是否会在《GTA6》之后很快推出另一款《GTA》游戏，或许将舞台转向另一座城市？

paragraphs.en: Many hope and expect Rockstar to make Red Dead Redemption 3, although Rockstar itself hasn’t indicated it has plans to do so. A year ago, Rockstar Games co-founder and former lead writer Dan Houser said RDR3 “will probably happen.” In 2023, Roger Clark, who played Arthur Morgan, the main playable protagonist of Red Dead Redemption 2, said he was “certain” fans would see Red Dead Redemption 3 “one day,” but qualified that statement by saying he had no idea when that would be. Clark also ruled out the return of Arthur Morgan in the game, should it come to be. If you’ve played Red Dead Redemption 2, this might seem like stating the obvious, but there’s always the chance Rockstar may consider another prequel of some kind.
paragraphs.cn: 许多人希望并期待Rockstar制作《荒野大镖客：救赎3》，但Rockstar本身并未表示有此计划。一年前，Rockstar联合创始人、前首席编剧Dan Houser曾表示，《荒野大镖客：救赎3》「很可能会有」。2023年，在《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中饰演主要可操控角色亚瑟·摩根的Roger Clark表示，他「确信」粉丝们「总有一天」会看到《荒野大镖客：救赎3》，但也补充说，他完全不知道那会是什么时候。Clark还表示，即便这款游戏真的问世，亚瑟·摩根也不会回归。如果你玩过《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，或许会觉得这话显而易见，但Rockstar始终有可能考虑再做一部某种形式的前传。

paragraphs.en: “I’m certain we will see Red Redemption 3 one day,” Clark said. “When that will be — I have absolutely no idea. Don’t count on Arthur’s involvement either. His story has been told, I feel.”
paragraphs.cn: Clark说：「我确信我们总有一天会看到《荒野大镖客：救赎3》。至于是什么时候，我完全不知道。也别指望亚瑟会参与其中。我觉得他的故事已经讲完了。」

paragraphs.en: In a subsequent interview with IGN , Clark expanded on his thoughts: “Yeah, that got really picked up! I would have thought that was obvious though. Wouldn’t you? And it’s not like I have any insider information whatsoever, but of course there’s going to be another Red Dead. It sold over 60 million copies!”
paragraphs.cn: 在随后接受IGN采访时，Clark进一步解释了自己的想法：「是啊，那番话被广泛报道了！不过我本以为这是显而易见的，你不觉得吗？我也没有任何内幕消息，但《荒野大镖客》当然会有下一作。它可是卖出了超过6,000万份！」

paragraphs.en: He continued: “Strauss Zelnick, the CEO of Take-Two said it himself. He said GTA and Red Dead are prominent franchises for Rockstar Games and that they will be returning to them in the future. So there’s no doubt there will be another Red Dead. But if Arthur Morgan will be involved? I highly doubt it, to be honest. And I think it’s going to be quite some time before we even see a snifter of anything new Red Dead related. I have no idea how it would pan out, but I wouldn’t bet on Arthur being a part of it.”
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说道：「Take-Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick亲口说过，《GTA》和《荒野大镖客》是Rockstar的重要系列，未来他们还会继续开发这两个系列。所以，《荒野大镖客》还会有新作，这毫无疑问。但亚瑟·摩根会不会参与其中？说实话，我很怀疑。而且我觉得，还得过相当长一段时间，我们才会看到哪怕一点与《荒野大镖客》新作有关的消息。我不知道它最终会是什么样，但我不会押注亚瑟会参与其中。」

paragraphs.en: In April this year, Hollywood star Jack Black revealed the character he’d love to play in Red Dead Redemption 3 , should Rockstar make the game: Jack Black. In lieu of a Red Dead Redemption movie, which Black said he’d very much love to star in if the opportunity ever came his way, the Bowser actor would love to star in Red Dead Redemption 3. And it turns out there’s a character called Jack Black he’d love to play.
paragraphs.cn: 今年4月，好莱坞影星杰克·布莱克透露，如果Rockstar制作《荒野大镖客：救赎3》，他最想饰演的角色是：杰克·布莱克。他表示，如果有机会，自己非常希望出演《荒野大镖客：救赎》电影。没有电影可演的话，这位酷霸王的配音演员也很想出演《荒野大镖客：救赎3》。而他想演的那个人，还真就叫杰克·布莱克。

paragraphs.en: "Red Dead Redemption 2 takes place around the turn of the century, right?" Black told Polygon while promoting The Super Mario Galaxy Movie . "There was a character around that time named Jack Black, who wrote an autobiography called You Can't Win. I would kinda like to play Jack Black in Red Dead Redemption 3."
paragraphs.cn: 布莱克在宣传《超级马力欧银河大电影》时向Polygon表示：「《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的故事发生在世纪之交前后，对吧？那个年代有个人叫杰克·布莱克，写过一本名为《You Can't Win》的自传。我还挺想在《荒野大镖客：救赎3》里饰演杰克·布莱克的。」
